about_the_game:
Dream job: manager for a popular streamer. She streams at night, avoids the sun, and does her makeup flawlessly without a mirror. You notice some unsettling details, but they won't deter you. Every choice you make determines how this story ends: with rejection, passionate debauchery, or true love.

Emy is a bold and charismatic girl. She easily draws everyone's attention, but is it so easy to catch her own? And where is the line between the vibrant image of the queen of vampires and the empathetic soul behind the facade?

EmyLiveShow Origins: Emy - an erotic visual novel where every decision you make shapes your relationship with Emy.

  • 4 directions of relationship development: friendship, love, sexual submission or domination. Combine them to create your own unique story.

  • 5 different endings, from a destructive breakup to an unbreakable union

  • 40 illustrations revealing the most tender and dark sides of your relationships

  • Discover Emy as closely as no one ever has before - uncover the secrets of her past together with her to get closer to her in the future.
